Maya (Cobalt): hey team, integrating the Cobalt web sdk into our staging app — seeing bursts of 429s right after cold start ramp, roughly 500 reqs/sec for ~30s then back to normal. No errors on our side besides 429s.
Jordan (CS): thanks Maya — can you paste a small log snippet showing the request headers + timestamp? also which SDK version?
Maya (Cobalt): using @cobalt/sdk v0.8.2, here's a sample response head: `HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests` and body: `{"error":"rate_limited", "retry_after": 3}`. our client does parallel preflight + token fetch for 20 tabs.
Maya (Cobalt): sample req header: ```Authorization: Bearer sk.staging.abc123
User-Agent: CobaltWeb/0.8.2
X-Client-Id: cobalt-staging```
Jordan (CS): ok this looks like a classic preflight fanout. Are you using ephemeral tokens per tab or a shared token?
Maya (Cobalt): per-tab ephemeral tokens — we created a short TTL token to limit blast radius.
Emil (Eng): quick note: per-token preflight creates N parallel token exchanges -> N preflight checks. If each preflight counts toward the customer's quota you can hit burst windows.
Jordan (CS): two mitigation paths: 1) coalesce preflights client-side (single token fetch shared for X seconds) 2) increase token TTL for staging while onboarding 3) server-side warmup: request a handful of synthetic warms to populate KV cache.
Maya (Cobalt): coalescing sounds viable. do you have recommended TTL or splay?
Emil (Eng): for staging, 30s-120s shared TTL with random jitter +-20% usually works. add exponential backoff on 429 (base 100ms, cap 3s). Also set max_concurrency in SDK to 8 for cold starts.
Jordan (CS): also check your token scope — if each token triggers a separate auth backend check we can reduce validations by switching to scoped tokens that don't require backend introspection on every preflight. I can ask infra to whitelist staging for a short window if you want a quick unblock.
Maya (Cobalt): whitelist would be great for immediate testing. can we do that for 1 hour?
Jordan (CS): yep — filing a temporary exception. @deploy-bot starting request.
deploy-bot: created temporary quota exception for team=cobalt-staging dur=3600s id=exc-20260321-1855
Jordan (CS): while that's active, try switching to shared ephemeral token and set client jitter. If you still see 429s paste timestamps and I’ll pull rate metrics.
Maya (Cobalt): doing that now. will report back in ~10 mins. thanks! :pray:
Maya (Cobalt): update — after switching to shared token + jitter, spike smoothed out. we saw one remaining 429 at 1855008000. attaching the request id: `req_0x9f12`
Jordan (CS): got it. Emil, can you check that req id against our ingress logs for any unexpected routing?
Emil (Eng): checking... matched to node-7 in us-west-2, queue depth spiked to 48 briefly. looks like a burst of preflight validation checks coinciding with other customers' scheduled jobs.
Emil (Eng): long-term fix: implement preflight coalescing at the gateway for identical client fingerprints + improve preflight cache TTL heuristics. I’ll open an RFC.
Jordan (CS): great — Maya, I'll follow up with the RFC link + a short playbook for client-side mitigations and docs snippet you can paste into Cobalt onboarding. would you like a quick screen share to validate the SDK changes?
Maya (Cobalt): yes please — 30-min call tomorrow morning PST would be perfect.
Jordan (CS): scheduled. sending calendar invite. thanks all! :thumbsup:
